vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek eats with A woman, maybe 40s — bowls side by side, talk low.

"Hey." A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Grace, Bodhi, Thabo and Adaeze met them at the door — 4 put down. Grace, Bodhi, Thabo are hurt.
🛡️ Grace, Bodhi, Thabo and Adaeze met them at the door — 4 put down. Grace, Bodhi, Thabo, Adaeze are hurt.
🛡️ Kurt, Bodhi and Thabo met them at the door — 3 put down. Kurt, Bodhi, Thabo are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Bodhi, Thabo, Adaeze and Victor met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Bodhi, Thabo, Adaeze, Victor are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rimma just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Elena, Olivia, Álvaro and Rimma met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 barely walked away. Elena, Olivia, Álvaro, Rimma are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Olivia just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rimma just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Olivia and Rimma met them at the door — 2 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chloe just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chloe just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
